title: Marketing website: unpublished wiki
description:
**As a** visitor and as an editor, **I want** an in-repo wiki on chattic.us that can hold durable notes (names for the category, peer products, concepts), **so that** Agent Zoo / Updates posts can link into a stable encyclopedia and wiki pages can point back at related posts.

This pass is **structure only**. Do not add the wiki to the footer or header. Do not treat an empty `/wiki` as a launch. Fill pages (starting with research) before publishing the wiki on the site.

This is **not** the Kanbus project wiki (`project/wiki`). That stays the internal board. This is a public marketing encyclopedia compiled into the static Next export.

## Locked decisions

- Route: `/wiki` index, `/wiki/[slug]` pages (slug routes mount when the first published page exists — same Next `output: export` constraint as the blog).
- Content: `web/content/wiki/*.md`. Flat for now.
- Unpublished: no footer/header link; index `robots: noindex` until we decide to publish.
- Bidirectional links in frontmatter now, even with zero pages: wiki `relatedPosts: [{ category, slug }]`, blog `relatedWiki: [slug]`. Missing targets are omitted, not a build failure.
- `draft: true` pages live in git as research notes and do not appear in listings or static params.

## Definition of Done

- `web/content/wiki/AGENTS.md` editor guide (wiki vs blog vs Kanbus wiki; how to link).
- Loader `web/lib/wiki.ts` with node:test.
- Empty `/wiki` index, noindex, not in the footer.
- Shared page factory like `web/lib/blog-post-page.tsx`.
- Blog frontmatter accepts optional `relatedWiki`.
- `features/marketing_wiki.feature` green.

## Out of scope

First published wiki pages, footer launch, nested wiki trees, CMS.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text: Structure pass complete. Unpublished /wiki plus draft research on names for the workplace. Launch (footer + index) is a later decision after more pages.
